exchanges: long day in the workshop, my hands are wrecked
Sounds like a soak and a sit down is in order.
been an upholsterer for years and i still love a good old armchair
It's great when the work still feels satisfying.
my wife brannagh thinks i love the chairs more than her lol
Ha, I'm sure she knows where she stands.
backs playing up, the physio reckons its sciatica
That's miserable, I hope they can sort it.
rafe's new wrangler is massive, he can barely park it
Big motors are a pain in tight spaces.
nothing planned tonight, might just order pizza
Pizza night sounds perfect.
my brother's playing lacrosse for some local team now, never saw that coming
Good on him for trying something new.
our girl ottilie has been singing nonstop all week
A little performer in the house, lovely.
work at marchbank is mad busy, everyone wants their sofas done at once
Busy is good for business at least.
devlin the apprentice glued his sleeve to a cushion today
Ha, a rite of passage for apprentices.
my brother in law flies hawks, falconry is his whole personality
That's a very cool and unusual pastime.
rain again, nobody wants to leave the house
Perfect weather for staying in.
rafe grew up in cairnholm, way up north, says it was freezing
Sounds like he's built for the cold then.
my daughter starts at fernleigh soon, im not ready
Big milestone, for both of you.
watching ironbark with the wife, we're hooked
Nice to have something you both enjoy.
sore back day, staying on the sofa
Rest up and take it easy.
rafe wants a pint at the weekend
Sounds like a good catch up.
my wife's birthday is coming up, no idea what to get her
Something thoughtful will always land well.
bought a projector for the back garden so we can do movie nights
Outdoor movie nights sound brilliant.
devlin's getting better, slowly
Good to hear he's coming along.
my brother in law brought one of his birds round, the kid loved it
What a memorable visit for her.
mum's coming over for lunch, id better tidy
Good luck with the tidying.
rafe's partner is called juno, shes a laugh
Sounds like a fun couple.
ok, time to sleep, back's killing me
Night, hope it eases off.
